headline_hook: An Eval Pipeline Accidentally Attacks Hugging Face While Anthropic Maps AI's Economic Future
preview_topics: a wave of open-weight model drops

pick_of_the_day.thesis: The accidental DDoS reveals that eval pipelines — the invisible plumbing of open model sharing — are an unguarded attack surface, and the industry's trust model for model distribution assumes a level of coordination that doesn't exist.

model_literacy.relevance: When OpenAI's automated evaluation hammered Hugging Face's infrastructure, it exposed how model-sharing pipelines can become unintentional weapons — understanding this failure mode is prerequisite to building resilient open-model infrastructure.
